description: RFC 0002 owned-file inventory. Each record resolves a file to its current owner and its target module, with responsibility/effect/state classification, provenance, and symbol-level splits for mixed files.

coverage.note: Seeded from the RFC 0002 observed-evidence table, the first geometry extraction candidate, and the extracted strict geometry module (now the world.map-geometry library, public/mapgeometry and mapgeometry, R08-LIBS). filesClassified counts authored records, which now include new strict-module files in addition to legacy hammer/ files. Exhaustive per-file/per-symbol classification is the H0 exit condition and is tracked as HAM-INVENTORY-001; validator enforces full coverage only when status is 'complete'. 2026-10-03 (R08-REPLACE-TEXTURES, HAM-REPLACETEX-001): 22 reviewed records for the files that slice read or changed, and the authored totals refreshed to the live universe that 'archlint hammer --coverage' measures (hammer/ plus the strict roots).

files.note: Common precompiled header pulls afxwin.h/afxext.h and Windows facilities. Removing a visible include does not establish portability; strict modules must not include this PCH.
CHammer combines MFC lifecycle and engine application-system composition. Bootstrap, service ownership, and UI lifetime need separate owners.

symbolSplits.note: MFC lifecycle retained on the legacy side of the seam.

files.note: CMapDoc derives from CDocument; editing state and operations cannot currently be instantiated independently of the MFC document layer.

symbolSplits.note: Mutations routed through the transaction boundary (HAM005).

files.note: Scene base exposes selection, rendering, transforms, persistence, and notifications. CMapAtom::SetParent accepts any parent; characterize the implicit base contract before extraction.

symbolSplits.note: Observed runtime-type narrowing vs CMapClass::SetParent; target API validates parent/child before mutation.

files.note: Broad base contract hides which behaviors each object actually supports; separate persistent content from render caches, UI state, and file encoding.
CSelection::SelectObject commits and invalidates property-dialog state; extracting selection must preserve the property-commit policy while removing the window dependency (HAM-SEL-001).

symbolSplits.note: Property-draft commit policy moves to the application layer; SaveData() coupling to the property sheet is removed.

files.note: CBaseTool has repeated 2D/3D/logical input entry points coupled to concrete view classes; normalize input and share gesture mechanics.
CMapView::GetViewWnd returns CWnd*; the current interface cannot serve an ordinary GTK or headless host. Split projection/picking/extraction from native window ownership.

IEditorTexture draws through CDC/RECT/CPalette; split asset metadata, decoded-image access, thumbnail generation, and private render bindings. Characterize GetImageWidth vs GetWidth before deduplication.

symbolSplits.note: Image vs mapping dimensions may differ; characterize before merge (do not treat the removal comment as evidence).

files.note: CVGuiWnd::DrawVGuiPanel passes native window handles into material-system views; native details must be confined to the private interop bridge.
CRender3D::BeginRenderHitTarget/EndRenderHitTarget convert object pointers to unsigned int and back; a 64-bit migration must replace pointer encoding with bounded pick identifiers (HAM009).

symbolSplits.note: GPU pick IDs index a frame-scoped table; they must not contain truncated object pointers.

files.note: Axis-aligned bounding box value type; depends only on mathlib/vector.h. First bounded geometry extraction candidate (HAM-GEOMETRY-001). Note the lone virtual IsIntersectingBox: characterize callers before deciding the extracted shape.
Implements BoundBox update/intersection/snap; extract with explicit grid/tolerance policy and preserve existing precision (HAM-GEOMETRY-001).

New strict public header: mapgeometry::AxisAlignedBox + Vec3, extracted from BoundBox. Dependency-free (only <cstddef>); no MFC/tier0/PCH. Owns its geometric value type per the hammer.geometry contract (HAM-GEOMETRY-001). R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

New strict implementation of AxisAlignedBox. Compiles headlessly under gcc and clang (-std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror); verified by unittests/hammertest/geometry/test_aabb.cpp via unittests/hammertest/run_headless.sh. SnapToGrid routes through mapgeometry::RoundHalfAwayFromZero (rounding.h) for legacy V_rint fidelity. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

Named owner of the grid-rounding policy (round half away from zero), extracted from hammer_mathlib V_rint. Consumed by AxisAlignedBox::SnapToGrid; the single authoritative definition of the snap rounding rule (DRY). R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

Verbatim port of hammer_mathlib.cpp V_rint (floor(f+0.5)/ceil(f-0.5)). Verified by unittests/hammertest/geometry/test_rounding.cpp, which pins the .5 boundaries where this differs from std::rint. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

Angle numeric policies (NormalizeAngleDegrees, LineAngleDegrees) extracted from hammer_mathlib fixang/lineangle. Preserves the legacy single-step wrap quirk and RAD2DEG expansion exactly; future rotation/2D tools will share this owner. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

Verbatim port of fixang/lineangle. Verified by test_angle.cpp (incl. the 720->360 legacy quirk) plus a full-modulo sensitivity provider that the oracle catches. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.geometry into the world.map-geometry library (mapgeometry/, namespace mapgeometry); record kept for provenance.

Strong runtime NodeHandle value type (document + slot index + generation). Distinct from persistent VMF ids, history identity, and GPU pick ids per the RFC state-ownership rules. Dependency-free (only <cstdint>).
Generational slot table issuing/validating NodeHandles for one document. Implements the RFC stale-reference check and independent-document isolation.
HandleTable implementation. Compiles headlessly under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by unittests/hammertest/scene/test_handle_table.cpp plus a stale-accepting negative provider.
Scene node graph and its mutation/query boundary (RFC 0002 H1). Handle-addressed; validated reparent (cycle/self/foreign-document) and atomic subtree delete. Consumes hammer.scene handles.

SceneGraph implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_scene_graph.cpp (no-cycle, atomic reparent/delete, stale rejection, two documents) plus a permissive negative provider.

Independent document history reference model (revision counter vs saved position, no-op neutrality, undo/redo). The RFC verification-strategy oracle for transaction/history semantics ahead of full H3 authority.

DocumentHistory implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_document_history.cpp (incl. undo-to-saved clears modified though revision advanced) plus a revision-based negative provider.
Multi-selection property aggregation (Unset/Single/Mixed) owning the RFC empty-vs-unset-vs-mixed distinction. Foundational value type for the HAM-SEL-001 selection/property worked migration.
PropertyValue implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_property_value.cpp plus an empty-as-unset negative provider that the oracle catches.

VMF/keyvalues document model, parser, writer, and versioned semantic comparator API. Foundation for the H2 persistence slice and the HAM-CORPUS-001 comparator; preserves unknown chunks. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.formats into the content.keyvalues-text library (kvtext/, namespace kvtext); record kept for provenance.

VMF/keyvalues parser/writer/comparator. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_keyvalues.cpp (parse, round-trip + unknown preservation, malformed diagnostics, comparator normalization) plus a permissive-comparator negative provider that the data-loss oracle catches. R08-LIBS (2026-09-25): moved from hammer.formats into the content.keyvalues-text library (kvtext/, namespace kvtext); record kept for provenance.

IFileStore port: narrow whole-file primitives (Read/Write/Rename/Remove/Exists) with declared atomic-replace semantics. Real providers and test fakes implement the same contract; enables save-failure atomicity testing via fault injection.
Transactional save policy owner: temp-write + atomic rename so a failed save preserves the prior file. Depends only on the IFileStore port.

SaveDocument implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_save_orchestrator.cpp (clean replace, temp-write and commit failures preserve prior, temp cleaned) with an in-memory fault-injecting fake, plus a truncate-then-write negative provider.

Headless editor document integrating the codec, history, and save seams into the RFC reference workflow (open/edit/undo/redo/save/reopen/compare). One history authority; undo restores recorded snapshots; detached load.

EditorDocument implementation. Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); the reference workflow runs end-to-end in test_editor_document.cpp (open VMF, edit, undo, redo, save, reopen, compare; no-op neutrality; save-position/modified interaction) plus a non-restoring-undo negative provider.

The single named owner of the Source Vector<->Vec3 and BoundBox<->AxisAlignedBox boundary policy (HAM-SOURCEADAPTER-001, contract adapters.source.vector_interop.v1). Non-strict: deliberately includes mathlib/vector.h and boundbox.h so the strict geometry library never has to. Shared seam under both thin UI siblings (hammer.adapters.mfc, hammer.adapters.gtk). Substitution guarantee proven against the real MSVC-compiled legacy BoundBox (architecture/hammer_legacy_parity.json).
Strict reusable core of MFC CUpdateHint: notify-code buckets + unioned AABB region on hammer.scene/world.map-geometry. HAM-UPDATEHINT-001, contract app.update_hint.v1.
Implementation of hammer::app::UpdateHint. Headless; verified gcc/clang/MinGW-Wine (HAM-UPDATEHINT-001).
ORPHANED DEAD CODE: in no .vpc and does not compile (unbalanced parens line 128; non-members m_Objects/nIndex). Superseded by hammer::app::UpdateHint (HAM-UPDATEHINT-001); retire when removed.

Legacy CUpdateHint declaration (CObject/CMapObjectList/BoundBox). Its intended model is reconstructed strictly as app.update_hint.v1; the MFC class becomes a thin shell marshalling CMapClass/BoundBox into hammer::app::UpdateHint. HAM-UPDATEHINT-001.
Real disk-backed IFileStore provider (HAM-DISKSTORE-001, ports.file_store.v1). Non-strict; uses <filesystem>.
Atomic whole-file Write (temp+rename). Verified against the shared IFileStore contract on gcc/clang/MinGW-Wine.

Thin GTK4/libadwaita UI sibling. Only toolkit glue; delegates all editor logic to hammer::app libraries. Builds to a real binary (HAM-GTKSHELL-001, adapters.gtk_shell.v1). Outside strict roots, so gtk native tokens are permitted.

Thin MFC UI sibling (CWinApp/CFrameWnd). Only toolkit glue; delegates all editor logic to the reusable hammer::app libraries. Builds to a real PE32+ GUI exe and its workflow runs under Wine (HAM-MFCSHELL-001, adapters.mfc_shell.v1). MFC native tokens permitted (non-strict, outside strict roots; hammer.adapters.mfc is the legacyHost).

EntitySelection: an ordered, deduplicated set of entity indices -- the view state a UI shell owns and the entity editor consumes. Plain value type, no editor policy. Part of the HAM-SEL-001 shared entity editor.
EntitySelection implementation (sorted-unique insert/remove/toggle/contains). Headless under gcc and clang (-Werror); verified by test_entity_editor.cpp.

CMapDoc's implementation: MFC message map and command handlers mixed with document edit operations. HAM-REPLACETEX-001 removed Replace Textures (ReplaceTextures, OnEditReplacetex, ReplaceTexFunc, FindInString) after parity; the rest remains legacy authority.

symbolSplits.symbol: CMapDoc message map and On* command handlers
symbolSplits.note: Menu/keyboard entry points; their behavior moves to ActionCatalog actions.
Route through EditSession operations as each workflow migrates.
Load-time texture replacement file; not part of HAM-REPLACETEX-001; still legacy.

files.note: The Face Edit sheet's material page (Texture Application). Its Replace... button was retired by HAM-REPLACETEX-001; the GTK Texture Application window's Replace... runs tools.replace_textures. The face inspector (presenters::FaceInspector) owns the page's rules in the new stack.
Declarations of CFaceEditMaterialPage; OnReplace removed by HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
The texture toolbar (current material). Its Replace... button was retired by HAM-REPLACETEX-001; the GTK object bar's current-material swatch and the Texture Application window replace it.
Declarations of CTextureBar; OnReplace removed by HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
The modal texture browser. Its Replace and Mark buttons were retired by HAM-REPLACETEX-001 (Mark is the dialog's mark only option); presenters::MaterialBrowser owns browsing in the new stack.
Declarations of CTextureBrowser; OnReplace and OnMark removed by HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
CMapFace: face content mixed with texture-coordinate generation and rendering. Its rescale rule in SetTexture is reproduced by ops::ReplaceMaterial (parity in HAM-REPLACETEX-001).

symbolSplits.note: scene::Side / FaceTexture; texture math in ops/texture_ops.
Extraction and the render core draw faces in the new stack.

files.note: CTextureSystem: the active texture list and name lookup. FindActiveTexture's name rule ('\\' to '/', case-insensitive) is RFC 0015's identity, owned by content.asset-identity in the new stack; material sizes come through IMaterialInfo.
Face texture operations, including Replace Textures (ReplaceMaterial, MarkMaterialUses) since HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
Implementation of texture_ops.h; names through content.asset-identity.
The named command layer over EditSession (catalog, dispatch); replace_material and mark_material since HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
Implementation of the command layer.
The Replace Textures dialog model (HAM-REPLACETEX-001): draft, defaults, validation, preview and legacy messages; applies through SessionCommands.
Implementation of the Replace Textures dialog model.
The one object a UI shell binds: session, tools, views and presenters, including the Replace Textures model.
Implementation of EditorWorkspace.
Action specs and routing; tools.replace_textures is a host action since HAM-REPLACETEX-001.
The action catalog's specs, enable and check rules.
The GTK Replace Textures window (HAM-REPLACETEX-001): widgets bound to ReplaceTexturesDialog.
Implementation of the GTK Replace Textures window.
The GTK shell's composition root and windows over EditorWorkspace: menus from the ActionCatalog, host requests (properties, replace_textures), the Texture Application window.
MFC dialog layout: CAnchorMgr resizes child HWNDs with SetWindowPos on OnSize; the GTK shell lays out its own widgets, so this retires with the dialogs.
Declares CAnchorDef/CAnchorMgr over HWND and dialog item IDs, the Win32 dialog-anchoring model that the GTK shell does not use.
CDispShoreManager builds shoreline segments from displacement and face data (Shoreline_t::AddSegment) and has Draw/DebugDraw through CRender3D; the geometry is derived and can be recomputed.
Declares ShoreFaceData_t, Shoreline_t and the IDispShoreManager interface over MapHelper/MapFace/MapOverlay types, so the shoreline geometry types can be extracted once those types are split.
Wraps Win32 CreateFile, CreateEvent and ReadDirectoryChangesW to watch directories and report changed filenames, a platform file-watch adapter.
Declares CFileChangeWatcher with ICallbacks and AddDirectory/Update, the interface over the Win32 directory watcher.
CFilteredComboBox subclasses CComboBox with an edit-control font, colour and suggestion filtering; this is Win32 combo-box control glue that GTK entry completion replaces.
Declares CFilteredComboBox : CComboBox with ICallbacks and suggestion methods, a Win32 control class with no domain state.
CSceneTokenProcessor and LoadFile read choreography .vcd scene files through the scriplib tokenizer and GetFirstSoundInScene resolves a scene's sound, an asset lookup over external files.
Declares GetFirstSoundInScene and forward-declares CChoreoScene, the scene-asset query used by the sound and scene preview paths.
CHammerVGui Init(HWND) starts the VGUI/MatSystem surface on the main window and pumps Simulate; it exists only to host the MFC VGUI panels that GTK does not use.
Declares CHammerVGui with HWND-based Init/Shutdown and VGUI focus tracking, the legacy VGUI host for the MFC shell.
CMapAxisHandle is a map helper that draws its axis handle in Render2D/Render3D and attaches to points, so the handle geometry and draw need to be separated from its document-side attachment.
Declares CMapAxisHandle : CMapHelper with Render2D/Render3D and the CToolAxisHandle attachment, mixing handle state with view drawing.
CMapDiffDlg is a modal dialog that browses for a .vmf, .rmf or .map file via CFileDialog and compares it with the open document; the comparison UI is replaced by the GTK host.
Declares CMapDiffDlg : CDialog with a static MapDiff(CWnd*, CMapDoc*) entry point, the MFC dialog shell.
CMapHelper is the base class for non-serialized helper objects (ShouldSerialize returns false, PrepareSelection), mixing scene-object policy with the MFC CMapClass base.
CModelBrowser is a CDialog hosting a vgui EditablePanel with an MDLPicker and saves its layout to an INI section (SaveLoadSettings); the browser UI is replaced by the GTK shell.
Declares CModelBrowser : CDialog with CModelBrowserPanel and CMDLPicker forward declarations, the MFC dialog shell over the VGUI model picker.
CNewVisGroupDlg is a CDialog that asks for a visgroup name and lists groups with a registered window message; the GTK visgroups panel replaces it.
Declares CNewVisGroupDlg : CDialog over CGroupList, the MFC new-visgroup dialog.

COP_Model::UpdateData reads the model's sequence names and feeds the combo suggestions, and OnSetActive/OnKillActive set the global Options.view3d.bAnimateModels, so the model editing rules need separating from the MFC page.
Declares COP_Model : CObjectPage and CFilteredComboBox::ICallbacks over GDclass and CMapStudioModel, the model property page's editing contract.
CObjectPage is the base for MFC property pages with a static s_bRESTRUCTURING flag and UpdateData(Mode) and OnSetActive; the GTK Object Properties window (R08-UI-PROPS) replaces it.
The header only defines IDM_POPUP_POINT_HANDLE 7, a Win32 popup-menu command ID; the GTK menus use ActionCatalog, so the constant retires with the MFC popups.

CRender holds the view's render mode, instance-rendering flag and studio render config (UpdateStudioRenderConfig) and draws through the material system, so view state and draw submission need splitting.
Declares EditorRenderMode_t and the CRender class over IMaterial, DrawModelInfo_t and CCoreDispInfo, combining the view's render settings with GPU draw calls.
DrawBoundsText projects a brush's bounds through CRender2D TransformPoint and draws measurement text with SetTextColor, a pure projection mixed with 2D drawing.
Declares DrawBoundsText(CRender2D*, ...) and its flags, the 2D measurement overlay helper.
CScenePreviewDlg is a CDialog that plays a CChoreoScene on a thread (EndThread, OnIdle) and drives the sound system; the GTK host replaces this preview window.
Declares CScenePreviewDlg : CDialog over CChoreoScene and a scene filename, the MFC scene preview shell.

Find/replace logic (MatchString, ReplaceString, FindCheck, FindReplace over CMapEntity keyvalues via SetKeyValue) is mixed with the CSearchReplaceDlg MFC dialog, so the matching rules must move to the app layer.
Declares FindObject_t (the search criteria) and CSearchReplaceDlg : CDialog with GetFindCriteria, so the criteria type belongs with the app-layer matcher.
CSelectModeDlgBar : CHammerBar is an MFC toolbar with BOOL Create(CWnd*), the select-mode bar replaced by GTK toolbar actions.
CSelection holds the document's selection list with SelectObjectList flags including scSaveChanges, which commits property-dialog edits, so selection policy and document commits need separating.
CSmoothingGroupMgr adds and removes faces from smoothing groups and sets angles, and its SaveVMF/LoadVMF chunk callbacks put the VMF format in the same class.
Declares ISmoothingGroupMgr with face-group operations and SaveVMF/LoadVMF over CChunkFile and CSaveInfo, combining the group model with VMF persistence.
CSoundBrowser is a CDialog that lists sounds with a filter history (m_nFilterHistory) and saves its values to an INI section; the GTK shell replaces the sound picker.
Declares CSoundBrowser : CDialog constructed from the current sound name, the MFC sound picker shell.

CToolAxisHandle pushes TOOL_AXIS_HANDLE on ToolManager, captures the view on mouse down and updates the document's views (UpdateAllViews), so the tool state machine must be separated from the MFC view input.
Declares CToolAxisHandle, an axis drag handle over CMapView2D/3D with CRender2D/3D references and no MFC message map or document write.
CBaseTool::Init stores a CMapDoc pointer and Activate calls UpdateAllViews, so the base tool is a view-refresh shim over MFC document types.
CToolBlockMessageWnd is a CWnd with a message map for 2D menus, and the block tool adds objects through MarkUndoPosition, AddObjectToWorld and KeepNew.
CToolBlock derives from Box3D and exposes CMapView2D/3D entry points; the header holds no document writes or window code.
Camera3D keeps the camera list that is saved with the map (SaveInfo and chunk callbacks), and its cursor and view handling use MFC view types.
The header declares the camera list with CChunkFile/CSaveInfo serialization and load callbacks, so the camera chunk belongs with the format library while the tool view logic stays in hammer.tools.
Clipper3D draws clip results through Render2D/Render3D, adds and deletes solids through MapDoc and History, and sets cursors on MFC views.
CClipGroup and Clipper3D declare the clip-plane state machine and a DrawBrushExtents(CRender2D*) draw entry over CMapSolid pointers.
The cordon tool is a 2D/3D drag tool that uses MFC cursor and view calls and makes no document writes in this file.
Cordon3D declares CChunkFile/CSaveInfo save and load hooks, so the cordon box it edits is persisted into the map and is document data.
The decal tool places decal entities through AddObjectToWorld with MarkUndoPosition and KeepNew, and uses MFC cursor and message calls.
CToolDecal is a base-tool declaration over CMapView2D/3D with no MFC message map or document write in the header.
The entity/prefab placement tool creates entities in the world through the document and history, draws its preview via Render2D/Render3D, and has a CWnd message window.
CToolEntity declares CRender2D/CRender3D draw hooks over CMapView2D/3D and no document writes in the header.
The magnify tool changes zoom through pView->SetZoom, so the zoom state lives in the view, and it issues one MFC cursor call.
CToolMagnify is declared over CMapView2D entry points; the zoom factor is applied to the view rather than stored by the tool.
CToolManager keeps the tool stack (Init, PushTool, PopTool) and registers VMF chunk load and save handlers that forward to each tool, so the chunk dispatch is a split candidate for the format owner.
CToolManager header lists the tool classes and the tool-stack API; its only file-related declaration is the chunk load callback.
The face-material tool applies textures through MarkUndoPosition and Keep on solids and drives the MFC CFaceEditSheet property sheet.
CToolMaterial is a base-tool declaration over CMapView2D/3D with no MFC message map or document write.
The 2,161-line morph tool records undo positions for its vertex edits, draws through the render views, and carries CMapView 2D/3D state.
Morph3D declares IMesh and CRender2D/3D draw hooks over the map views for the morph handles.
The overlay tool adds the new overlay to the world with MarkUndoPosition and KeepNew, and its shoreline computation is pure geometry math.
The overlay tool header is declared over CMapDoc and CMapView3D and holds Shoreline_t records, so its MFC coupling keeps it in the adapter.
The pick-angles tool computes an angle from a 3D view click, reports it through IPickAnglesTarget, and makes one MFC cursor call.
CToolPickAngles and IPickAnglesTarget are declared over CMapView3D with no MFC message map in the header.
The entity picker picks entities from the map views and reports selections to its target, with one MFC cursor call.
CToolPickEntity, SelectedEntity_t and IPickEntityTarget are declared over CMapView3D and CMapViewLogical with no document writes in the header.
The point-handle tool has a CWnd message window with nine native-UI matches and edits origins through MarkUndoPosition and Keep on the selection.
CToolPointHandle declares CRender2D/CRender3D draw hooks over CMapView2D and no document writes in the header.
The 1,984-line Selection3D tool owns the selection list, transforms selected objects in place (TransformSelection) under the history, and draws through the render views.
Selection3D declares selection over CMapView2D/3D and CMapWorld with CRender2D/3D draw hooks and no MFC message map.
The sphere tool changes the radius through MarkUndoPosition and Keep on the selection, and its geometry math is pure.
CToolSphere over CMapSphere with CMapView2D/3D entry points and no document writes in the header.
CTorusDlg is an MFC CDialog with DDX controls and two preview controls (IDC_PREVIEW and the top-view preview), so the GTK host replaces it.
CVGuiWnd and CVGuiPanelWnd host a vgui EditablePanel in an MFC CWnd, override WindowProc and DrawVGuiPanel, and are replaced by the GTK host.
activeitemlist.h is a header-only generic ActiveItemList template with no MFC or Windows types.
Transport-free JSON-RPC handler that forwards each tool call to the injected command layer, with no file or native UI calls in this file.
McpServer declares the transport-free JSON-RPC surface over an injected catalog and execute function; it is the MCP adapter, not MFC.
DiskByteStore reads byte ranges with std::ifstream and std::filesystem, the disk provider for the byte-store port.
